g.text: A static right arm anatomical reference
Ten named structures from BodyParts3D 4.0. Original atlas pose and topology are preserved.
Converted from mm to m for data export. Colors are explanatory additions.
A reduced reference atlas supplies gross shape; it does not supply a validated elbow joint or muscle mechanics.
